ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
lz4_c:
- '1.10'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
zstd:
- '1.5'
name: dectris-compression
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: dectris-compression
  version: "0.4.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7d0a6576a6611be4a2da7ad7911f9c3b34105c29c397a6975cc2622eca9de80f
  patches:
    - unvendor-lz4.patch
    - unvendor-zstd.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: unix
      then: rm -rf third_party/lz4
      else: rmdir /s /q third_party\lz4
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - wheel
    - pip
    - lz4-c
    - zstd
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - dectris.compression
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: DECTRIS compression algorithms
  license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    # vendors a patched, faster version of bitshuffle from https://github.com/kalcutter/bitshuffle
    - third_party/bitshuffle/LICENSE-APACHE
    - third_party/bitshuffle/LICENSE-MIT
  homepage: https://github.com/dectris/compression
  repository: https://github.com/dectris/compression

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - beenje
